title: Golden Ratio (φ)
subtitle: Algebraic constant · Geometry
summary: The unique positive solution to x² = x + 1.
detail:
\[ \varphi = \frac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2} = 1.61803398874989\ldots \]

Satisfies \(\varphi^2=\varphi+1\) and \(1/\varphi=\varphi-1\). Appears in Fibonacci numbers (\(F_n/F_{n-1}\to\varphi\)), the regular pentagon, phyllotaxis in plants, and the Penrose tiling. Its continued fraction \([1;1,1,1,\ldots]\) converges most slowly of all irrationals.
